reason: B is honest about the A1C numbers (small, self-selected group, medication changes not tracked), and it covers what a wary person who has quit before worries about: no contract, cancel any time, meal swaps, a menu that rotates so it doesn't get boring, and a phone call with the dietitian before I start. A omits all of that and leaves out the medication caveat, so B makes me much more willing to pay $59 for the trial week.
